title: When the Locker Breaks
author: Wendell Marchetti
blurb: Bram Eriksen, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
